title: Triac-dimmed LED illuminance control with external-light compensation: bench data, firmware and calibrated simulation
description:
Data, original source code and calibrated simulation supporting a study of closed-loop illuminance control of triac-dimmed retrofit LED lamps with external-light compensation at low illuminance (10–33 lx at the sensor). The bench prototype (BH1750 sensor, Arduino Mega acquisition, MATLAB-hosted 3-rule Mamdani inference, Arduino Uno with a triac dimmer shield) was developed in the M.Sc. dissertation of J. A. Carvalho Neto (Unesp, 2021).

Contents: sensor calibration pairs (n = 26 and n = 22); triac/dimmer voltage tables; single-run bench records (setpoint tracking and external-light steps); per-cycle traces digitised from the original plots, with the source images and digitisation script; the original Arduino and MATLAB code; and a simulation that identifies the plant from the bench records, validates it in closed loop and compares the fuzzy controller with on/off (hysteresis) and integral baselines by Monte Carlo.

All dynamic bench tests are single runs (n = 1). Baseline comparisons are simulated, not measured. No power or energy data are included. Code is MIT-licensed; data are CC BY 4.0.
